### A Call to Repentance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-to-repentance
Passage: Jeremiah 3:14
Points:
- Outward religious reforms cannot substitute for genuine, inward heart transformation.
- God called long-exiled Israel to repent to teach Judah that restoration was still attainable.
- Though covenant unfaithfulness seemed to sever the marriage relationship forever, God makes reconciliation possible.
- The Lord promises to receive back and restore all who turn to Him in true contrition.
- Believers can rest confident in God's boundless grace and willingness to pardon through Christ.

### Reclaiming Life
Author: Andrea
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/reclaiming-life-encouragement-caf-apr-10-2015.html
Passage: Jeremiah 3:15
Points:
- Childhood emotional wounds and church hypocrisy can lead individuals into long, deceptive detours.
- Seeking fulfillment away from God produces a false sense of peace that ignores divine conviction.
- God sends caring shepherds into our lives to show His love and guide wanderers back to the fold.
- Inner healing is an ongoing process of replacing past lies with biblical truth.
- Believers are urged to pray persistently and extend love rather than condemnation to wayward friends.
